fusions.name: Cutting Remark
fusions.desc: Casts a crescent that deals 12 damage and leaves the target [Vulnerable] for 8 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Full Stop
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. Sweeps a full circle that deals 8 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Repeated Clause
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

fusions.name: Fresh-Cut Reagent
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your next spell deals 25% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
